inventory.recon_scope: Initial source-backed reconnaissance of Android AVD, Termux runtime smoke, Game Player machine-profile contract and device-pull-queue design. Not a complete repository-wide module census.

tool_profiles.name: Android Studio AVD / Android Emulator — StudySprint smoke profile

privileges: KVM when available; emulator software acceleration fallback

tool_profiles.name: QEMU system/user emulation
tool_profiles.adapter_contract: Candidate reference only; no repository adapter or installed host is claimed.

privileges: Depends on acceleration and guest configuration

exclusions: Android UI/API fidelity without a separately validated Android guest image

security.isolation: Guest isolation must be reviewed; QEMU process is not a complete security boundary by itself
security.network_egress: Default deny; explicitly configure virtual network
security.secret_policy: Do not pass host secrets to guest
security.data_retention: Disposable disk images; snapshot sanitization required

evidence.notes: QEMU identified as architecture-emulation candidate; no configured runtime established.

tool_profiles.next_recon: Choose one architecture-specific workload and compare QEMU user/system mode, native cross-compilation and Android AVD where appropriate.

tool_profiles.name: Physical Android / Termux device

privileges: User-authorized ADB/Termux permissions; root is not assumed

exclusions: No device identity or current connectivity is established by this record

security.isolation: Dedicated test profile, explicit user consent and device-lab policy required
security.secret_policy: No personal profile export, MFA bypass or secret serialization
security.data_retention: Redact device identifiers and personal data; preserve only approved test evidence

resource_profile.cost_basis: Device/lab ownership and operator time; not measured

evidence.notes: Historical architecture is explicitly stale and does not establish live device or MCP availability.

tool_profiles.next_recon: Only enroll a device after explicit owner approval, current device info, authorized bridge verification, safety/privacy review and reset procedure.
